title: checkout_abandonment_rate — attempt-based abandonment signal with honest right-censoring
hypothesis: checkout_abandonment_spike is blind by construction: abandoned checkouts stay `created` and never produce terminal events, so outcome-based series cannot see them. An attempt-based metric — share of payments created in a bucket that reach no terminal outcome within a 30-min inactivity threshold — sees the spike cleanly (measured baseline ~0.04 vs spike 0.4-0.8 stuck share).

dataset.ground_truth: checkout_abandonment_spike 2026-08-21T12:30..15:00Z (18:00-20:30 IST), abandon_boost +0.45 over NATURAL_ABANDON_RATE 0.04, affected INR 69,201 (recoverable=True)

metric_definition.name: checkout_abandonment_rate
metric_definition.bucket_value: abandoned / decidable attempts created in the bucket
metric_definition.abandoned: no terminal outcome within created + inactivity_threshold
metric_definition.right_censoring: attempts with created + threshold > window_end (the pass's knowledge edge) are excluded from numerator AND denominator; events after window_end are never consulted (no future leakage)
metric_definition.floors: min_bucket_count 10 decidable creations (metric default), min_absolute_deviation 0.20, min_observed 0.35, min_flagged_volume 15 (global default), min_flagged_run 2 (global default), z >= 3

candidate_history: v1 floors (count 5, abs 0.10, no min_observed): 4 organic FPs on standard-42 — natural abandonment clumps of 1-2 stuck payments on tiny night/morning buckets (share up to 1.0 on 2-7 decidable creations)
v2 final floors: 0 abandonment FPs on standard-42, quiet-42, standard-7

selection: floors selected on standard-42 measured organic vs injected separation (organic stuck <= 2/bucket, share <= 0.2 on >= 10 decidable creations; injected spike 15-25 stuck/bucket, share 0.4-0.8); validated on quiet-42 and standard-7 (0 FPs both)
